truth.site_note: city centre; the clip's room is not stated, the city spans 125 to 410 m
truth.source: WGS 84 normal gravity (Somigliana's formula, NIMA TR8350.2) with the free-air correction for height

clock.note: the hand angle is read from yellow pixels and can be pulled by the pendulum's yellow string near the dial; taken at face value the reading points the other way (a camera running fast would make g still higher), and a 2% clock error is far beyond a mechanical stopwatch's or a camera's, so the reading bounds the clock rather than measuring it

amplitude.model: full nonlinear pendulum (sin theta), so no amplitude bias in the fit

reference_plane: not applicable: no reference object in the clip; the scale comes from the stated length
